name: Simple Mini Golf
description:
Simple Mini Golf is a simple 2D top down mini golf game playable up to 8 players. You can chose between 9 holes and a 18 hole track with a total of 45 holes in 3 nine hole tracks and one 18 hole track. Play with your friends from two up to 8 players. Just minigolf but so good and fun! Can you play all holes par?

Features :
- 45 different holes
- 3x 9 Hole track and 1x 18 Hole track
- Up to 8 players (Hot seat mode)
